symptomLabel: Laptop not charging

questions.text: Does the charging LED turn on when plugged in?
Does the laptop work normally on battery power alone?
Does charging work intermittently when the cable is wiggled?
Have you tested with another known working charger?

symptomLabel: Laptop won't turn on

questions.text: Do you hear the internal fans spin or feel airflow?
Does any power indicator light light up when pressing the power button?
Have you held the power button for 30 seconds to perform a hard reset?
Can you see a faint backlight on the screen in a dark room?

symptomLabel: Laptop overheating or thermal throttling

questions.text: Is the cooling fan constantly running at maximum speed or making grinding noises?
Does the laptop shut down abruptly during games or video editing?
Are the heat exhaust vents clear of visible dust?

symptomLabel: Laptop screen flickering, lines, or black display

questions.text: Does the laptop display properly when connected to an external TV or monitor?
Does the screen glitch or change when opening or closing the lid hinge?
Is there any visible crack or bleeding ink patch on the glass panel?

symptomLabel: Cracked smartphone glass or damaged OLED/LCD

questions.text: Does the touch screen still respond accurately to your touches across the whole surface?
Are there colored vertical lines or dark ink-like bleed spots on the screen?
Is the aluminum or plastic phone frame noticeably bent?

symptomLabel: Fast battery drain or phone shutting down early

questions.text: Does the battery percentage jump down abruptly (e.g., from 40% to 5%)?
Is the back glass or screen slightly lifting up or bulging outwards?
Does the phone feel warm even when sitting idle in your pocket?

symptomLabel: Smartphone not charging or loose USB-C/Lightning cable

questions.text: Does the charging connector sit flush without wobbling inside the port?
If supported, does the phone charge on a wireless charging pad?
Have you inspected the charging port for compacted pocket lint?

symptomLabel: Water or liquid ingress

questions.text: Did you immediately turn the phone off and leave it disconnected from power?
Is there visible condensation or fog inside the camera lenses?
Are the speakers sounding crackly, muffled, or silent?

symptomLabel: Headphones or earbuds silent on one side

questions.text: Have you verified the audio balance slider in your device settings is centered?
For wired models, does audio briefly cut in when bending the wire near the jack or earcup?
For in-ear earbuds, have you cleaned or inspected the mesh sound filter for wax buildup?

symptomLabel: Wireless headphones disconnect or pairing fails

questions.text: Does the power/status LED illuminate reliably every time you power on?
Have you performed a factory reset and cleared previous Bluetooth pairings?
Does the audio cut off within a few minutes of disconnecting from the charger?

symptomLabel: Rattling, buzzing, or distorted audio

questions.text: Does the rattling noise happen even at moderate and low volume levels?
Does distortion only appear during heavy bass frequencies?
If ANC is turned off, does the strange buzzing or high-pitched squeal disappear?

symptomLabel: Cracked headband, broken swivel hinge, or worn ear pads

questions.text: Is the internal wire running through the hinge visibly pinched or frayed?
Does sound still play cleanly in both ears if you hold the broken pieces together?
Are there loose or missing tiny screws at the folding joint?

symptomLabel: Laptop running very slow or freezing

questions.text: Is your hard drive or SSD nearly full?
Do you have many tabs or heavy apps running simultaneously?

symptomLabel: WiFi disconnecting or not finding networks

questions.text: Can other devices connect to your WiFi fine?
Is Airplane mode turned off?

symptomLabel: Trackpad not responding or jumping

questions.text: Does an external USB mouse work fine?
Is the trackpad physically bulging upwards?

symptomLabel: Camera app crashing or photos blurry

questions.text: Is the outer glass covering the camera visibly cracked or scratched?
Does the camera app show a black screen or crash immediately?

symptomLabel: Power or volume buttons not clicking

questions.text: Do the buttons feel 'mushy' and lack a distinct click?
Does the issue persist even when the phone case is removed?

symptomLabel: No cellular signal or dropped calls

questions.text: Have you tried removing and reinserting the SIM card?
Does the phone connect to WiFi without issues?

symptomLabel: Charging case won't charge or power on

questions.text: Have you tested the charging cable with another device?
Is there lint or debris in the case's charging port?

symptomLabel: Microphone not picking up voice in calls

questions.text: Do callers say you sound very muffled or distant?
Does the mic work if you record a local voice memo?

symptomLabel: TV powers on but screen is completely black or no display

questions.text: Can you hear audio/sound from the TV even though the screen is dark?
When shining a bright flashlight close to the dark screen, can you faintly see an image or menu?
Is the standby power LED blinking in a repeating pattern or color code?

symptomLabel: Horizontal or vertical colored lines appearing across the TV display

questions.text: Do the lines appear on all HDMI inputs and internal smart TV menus?
Was the screen physically pressed, hit, or cleaned with liquid recently?
Do the lines flicker or change position when lightly pressing near the frame edge?

symptomLabel: Picture is normal but TV has no sound or distorted audio

questions.text: Is the sound missing from both built-in TV speakers and external audio/soundbars?
Have you verified that the TV audio output is set to Internal Speakers and not Optical/Bluetooth?
Do you hear a loud buzzing or popping noise before the audio cuts out?

symptomLabel: Washing machine fills with water but drum does not spin or agitate

questions.text: Can you hear the motor humming or attempting to rotate during the spin cycle?
Can you easily rotate the drum smoothly by hand when the machine is turned off?
Has all the water completely drained before the spin cycle begins?

symptomLabel: Water puddle forming underneath or around the washing machine

questions.text: Does water leak immediately when the machine starts filling?
Is the front door rubber bellow seal/gasket torn, dislodged, or mouldy?
Does water only leak during the drain or high-speed spin cycle?

symptomLabel: Refrigerator or freezer compartment is warm and not cooling

questions.text: Can you hear the compressor humming or vibrating at the back bottom of the fridge?
Does the fridge make a regular clicking sound every few minutes at the back?
Are the interior lights working when opening the door?

symptomLabel: Heavy ice or frost buildup covering the freezer walls and coils

questions.text: Is ice blocking the air vents between the freezer and fresh food compartment?
Can you slide a sheet of paper easily through the magnetic door gasket when closed?
Does the ice return within 2-3 days after manually defrosting?

symptomLabel: AC blows room-temperature or warm air instead of cold air

questions.text: Is the outdoor condenser fan spinning and motor running when AC is turned on?
Is there frost or ice forming on the thin copper pipes at the outdoor unit?
Have the indoor unit dust mesh filters been cleaned in the past month?

symptomLabel: Water dripping or leaking down the wall from indoor AC unit

questions.text: Is water freely flowing out of the external outdoor drain pipe?
Is ice visible on the indoor cooling fins behind the filter?
Does the dripping stop completely when the AC is switched off?

symptomLabel: Router WAN / Internet LED is glowing solid red or orange

questions.text: Is the Ethernet/fiber optic cable firmly locked into the WAN/Internet port?
Can your phone or laptop still see and connect to the local WiFi SSID name?
Have you unplugged power for 30 seconds and restarted the device?

symptomLabel: WiFi connection repeatedly drops and reconnects every few minutes

questions.text: Do all connected devices lose connection simultaneously?
Is the router casing unusually hot to the touch?
Does a wired Ethernet cable connection stay stable while WiFi drops?

symptomLabel: Paper repeatedly jams or gets stuck in the feed roller mechanism

questions.text: Are there small scraps of torn paper stuck inside the feed tray or roller path?
Do the rubber pickup rollers spin when trying to pull in paper?
Does the printer make a loud gear grinding or screeching noise?

symptomLabel: Printed pages have white horizontal lines, faded text, or smeared colors

questions.text: Have you run the built-in automated printhead cleaning cycle 2-3 times?
Are the physical ink tanks or toner cartridges at least 25% full?
Has the printer sat unused for more than 4 weeks?

symptomLabel: Burning smell or sparks coming from the mixer grinder base

questions.text: Can you see yellow/orange sparks through the bottom ventilation vents?
Did the red overload protection button at the bottom pop out?
Can you rotate the blender jar coupler easily with your fingers?

symptomLabel: Liquid leaks out from under the blender jar blade assembly into the machine

questions.text: Is there black powder or dirty grease around the jar coupler gear?
Is the central blade shaft wobbly or loose inside the brass bush?
Is the silicone/rubber O-ring washer cracked or missing?

symptomLabel: Kettle switch turns on and light glows, but water stays cold

questions.text: Does the power indicator lamp or LED illuminate when switched on?
Are the copper terminal pins on the swivel base blackened or scorched?
Does the power switch click firmly and stay down?

symptomLabel: Fan sounds like a jet engine and console shuts down with overheating warning

questions.text: Are the exhaust vents clogged with visible dust blankets or pet hair?
Does the console display a "System is too hot" warning before shutting off?
Is the console casing very hot near the power supply / APU heatsink area?

symptomLabel: Console powers on (white/blue light) but TV displays "No Signal"

questions.text: Are any copper pins inside the HDMI port bent, pushed back, or missing?
Have you tested the HDMI cable and TV port with another working device?
Does the console display video when booting into Safe Mode / Low Resolution?

symptomLabel: Power bank casing is bulged, separated at the seams, or swollen

questions.text: Has the battery expansion caused the plastic or aluminum shell to pop open?
Do you smell a faint sweet chemical or nail-polish-like odor?
Does the battery pack feel warm even when not plugged into anything?

symptomLabel: Power bank shows 4 full LEDs but drains to 0% after charging phone for 10 mins

questions.text: Do the LED indicators drop from 4 bars to 1 bar almost immediately under load?
Has fast charging (PD / QC) stopped working completely?
Does the power bank take 12+ hours to show 100% when recharging?

symptomLabel: Smartwatch battery drains completely within 3 to 6 hours

questions.text: Does it drain fast even with Always-On-Display and continuous GPS disabled?
Does the back ceramic/glass plate feel noticeably warm against your wrist?
Is the display glass lifting or separating from the casing due to battery swell?

symptomLabel: Smartwatch does not charge or magnetic puck fails to connect

questions.text: Are the metal charging contact points on the back blackened or discolored from sweat?
Have you tested with a different USB power brick (5V 1A)?
Does the charging lightning bolt icon flicker on and off when moved?

symptomLabel: Tablet touchscreen registering phantom touches or dead zones

questions.text: Does the touch ghosting persist after removing any tempered glass protector?
Does the phantom touching happen only when connected to a charger?
Is the tablet chassis slightly bent or warped when looking down the edge?

symptomLabel: USB-C / Lightning port loose, tablet only charges at a specific angle

questions.text: Does the charging cable feel loose and fall out easily?
Can you see packed pocket lint or debris deep inside the port?
Does the tablet show a persistent "Liquid/debris in port" warning?

symptomLabel: Microwave runs, timer counts down and turntable spins, but food stays ice cold

questions.text: Do you hear a loud strained buzzing or humming sound when cooking starts?
Is there a burning electrical or ozone smell coming from the unit?
Does the microwave trip the home circuit breaker after running 5 seconds?

symptomLabel: Sparks, fire flashes, or crackling noise inside the cooking chamber

questions.text: Is the cardboard/mica waveguide cover on the right interior wall scorched or greasy?
Have you verified that no metallic foil, gold-rim plates, or cutlery are inside?
Is there bare rusted metal or chipped paint exposed on the inner walls?

symptomLabel: Lens stuck halfway, zoom motor clicks and displays "Lens Error"

questions.text: Did the camera recently encounter sand, fine dust, or a beach environment?
Was the camera dropped while the zoom lens barrel was extended?
Can you hear a faint electric motor whirring or clicking trying to retract?

symptomLabel: Speaker rattles, buzzes, or sounds muffled on bass notes

questions.text: Does the rattling/distortion occur even at 30% volume?
Is the rubber surround ring on the side bass radiators torn or punctured?
Does pressing gently on the outer plastic/metal grille stop the vibration rattle?

symptomLabel: PC powers on, fans and LEDs spin, but monitor screen stays black with no signal

questions.text: Does the motherboard emit beep codes or show a red/orange debug LED (CPU/DRAM/VGA)?
Is the HDMI/DisplayPort cable plugged into the dedicated graphics card rather than the motherboard?
Have you attempted removing and firmly reseating the RAM sticks into their slots?

symptomLabel: Motor runs loudly but vacuum cleaner has little to no suction power

questions.text: Have the HEPA and foam pre-motor filters been washed and allowed 24h to dry?
Can you see clear light through the detachable flexible hose and wand tube?
Is the cyclone cone or dustbin gasket sealed properly without air leaks?

symptomLabel: Filtered pure water trickles out as a thin drip or tank takes 4+ hours to fill

questions.text: Is your home main inlet water pressure adequate?
Is reject/waste water flowing out heavily through the blue drain pipe?
Has it been over 9 to 12 months since sediment and carbon pre-filters were replaced?

symptomLabel: Device will not power on, no LED indicator lights or signs of life

questions.text: Have you tested the wall electrical socket with a lamp or known-working appliance?
Is the power adapter cord, plug, or wire frayed, kinked, or chewed?
Does holding the power or pinhole reset button for 15 seconds trigger any reaction?
